name: OberVave
intro: One deep 8-voice analog-style polysynth in the spirit of the 1979-84 classics, with arp, chorus, delay, plate reverb and a two-track sequencer: turn PRESETS and play.

rows.what: PERFORM page: CUTOFF, RESO, ENV AMT, RELEASE.
Tempo, on every screen.
Pick track A or B.
Octave down (OCT+ up); both together: back to 0.
Lock a held layer open; its button lets it go.
Pick one of 99 programs (1-64 factory sounds).
Arpeggiator mode; OFF switches it off.
On the ARP page: HOLD latches the arp.
A new random sound, within useful ranges.
OSC 1, OSC 2, OSC MOD, FILTER, FILTER +; tap for next.
FILTER ENV; tap again for AMP ENV.
LFO, LFO DEST, LFO + pages; tap for next.
VOICE page: POLY / DUAL / UNISON / MONO, glide.
OUTPUT page: VINTAGE voice drift, SPREAD, BEND, VOLUME.
Full-screen sequencer; tap again for its next view.
Start / stop the sequencer.
Playing: record on top. Stopped: armed, first note starts.
2 seconds: clear the chosen track.
Set a step with the last note or chord; again clears.
Undo the last sequencer change (OCT+: redo).
Switch track B on (16 steps).
Mute track A (key 2: B; keys 5 / 6: solo).
Go to pattern 1-8 (playing: at the loop's end).
CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB pages; tap for next.
Chorus mix (KNOB 2 delay, 3 reverb, 4 delay time).
TRACKS: track B's own sound's FX SEND.
Save the sound in its program slot.
Save the sound into another slot.
In the sequencer: save the pattern now.
Copy this pattern to slot 1-8 (used slot: press twice).
GLOBAL: TEMPO, CLICK, MIDI CH, TUNE.
Click: OFF, REC, ON, COUNT-IN.
MIDI channel or OMNI; the next channel plays B's sound.
Tap tempo (G5).

tips: An edited sound shows * after its name; turn PRESETS before saving and the edit is gone.
SAVE arms for 3 seconds (the page shows SAVE?); tap it again in time.
Track B can play sound A or its own program: choose B with ALGORITHM, then turn PRESETS. The panel then edits B's sound (orange B in the header).
Patterns save themselves 3 s after a change once the sequencer is stopped.
Effect mixes belong to each program; the INIT sound starts dry.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- while powering on: USB rescue screen for reinstalling.
checked: v1.5 archive, firmware/src/platform.c: FM-1 button / encoder enums (BTN_SEL = the SEL button; on SMK-37 SCALE).

obervave.c app_main: layer buttons SEQ EDIT GLO SAVE FX (tap < 600 ms untouched = pages, hold = layer); HOME = PERFORM, with a held layer = lock, again = unlock; ENV cycle_page(PG_FENV,2), LFO cycle_page(PG_LFO,3), EDIT cycle_page(PG_OSC1,5), FX cycle_page(PG_CHORUS,3), GLO GLOBAL -> VOICE -> OUTPUT.

obv_params.h PAGE table: PERFORM CUTOFF RESO ENV AMT RELEASE(amp); VOICE MODE VOICES DETUNE GLIDE; OUTPUT VINTAGE SPREAD BEND VOLUME; ARP K1 = ARP mode (OFF default); NPROG 99, NFACT 64; FX mix defaults 0.

obervave.c: ARP on PG_ARP toggles hold bit; OCT range -2..+2, both = 0; SELECT = tempo 40-240 always; ALGORITHM = seq_trk A/B; PRESETS = program, save slot when save_armed, B's sound when track B chosen, pattern in sequencer except TRACKS view.
obervave.c: PLAY start/stop; REC acts on release < 700 ms (playing -> REC_ON, stopped -> REC_READY), held > 2000 ms clears seq_trk; EDIT + OCT-/OCT+ swaps undo_pat (pattern only).

obervave.c keys_in / seq_key_down / seq_key_up: SEQ layer white keys = steps (empty -> set with pen chord, set + released untouched -> cleared); EDIT layer erase_note; GLO glo_key KEY_STEP 0/1 mute, 4/5 solo, 15 (G5) tap tempo; SAVE layer white 1-8 pat_go, black 1-8 pat_copy (used slot: again within 3 s).
obervave.c SAVE tap: in sequencer pat_save_to; else save_armed (3 s, PRESETS picks slot, header SAVE?) then prog_put; SAVE held + BTN_SEL = randomize().

obervave.c seq_view_turn: a track with length 0 gets 16 steps from KNOB 1 on any view; TRACKS K2 LEVEL, K3 CUTOFF, K4 FX SEND (B_DRY, only with B's own sound). FX layer knobs P_CHO_MIX, P_DLY_MIX, P_REV_MIX, P_DLY_TIME.
obervave.c GLOBAL page knobs: TEMPO, CLICK (OFF REC ON COUNT-IN), MIDI CH (0 = OMNI), TUNE; midi_in: channel+1 = track B's own sound.
obervave.c line ~1903: pattern autosave 3 s after edit while stopped; load_program overwrites live (edits lost).
platform.c 451 + bootguard.h bootguard_manual: OCT- alone at power-on -> recovery_main (USB RESCUE screen, audio off).
unsure: README says 'SAVE held + SELECT pressed' for the random sound; the code reads BTN_SEL, which on the FM-1 is the SEL button (platform.c enum), so the sheet says SEL. Not tried on hardware.
README program table still says 32 programs; code at v1.5 has 99 (64 factory). Sheet follows the code.
Step views (STEPS / STEP+ / TRACK / PATTERNS knobs), SEQ black keys = step pages, held-step knobs, long notes, EDIT layer SHIFT / LENGTH / TRANSPOSE: verified but left out as too detailed.
MIDI CC map (74 cutoff, 71 reso, from CC 20 up in table order) and MIDI clock follow: from README/params table, not given a section.
